name: @zhenre/message
description: @zhenre message — typed postMessage protocol: pub/sub, request/reply with ids and timeouts, origin allowlisting. Works across Window, Worker and MessagePort. Zero dependencies.

scripts.build: esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --outfile=dist/message.js && esbuild src/index.ts --bundle --format=esm --minify --outfile=dist/message.min.js && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json
